items.name: Dual FMC and More Maine 2026
items.information:
**This competition will not be holding 3x3 but will instead be featuring Fewest Moves (FMC),  3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind, and Big Cubes (5x5-7x7). While first time competitors are welcome to compete, you may want to check out other competitions with more commonly held events.**

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3hrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ae8bf56bdf7df2a9ddef232b67ef1762d8b05535/logo_200x200.png)

This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England.

* [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.cubenewengland.com)
* [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.cubenewengland.com/competitions)
* [Follow us on **Facebook**](https://facebook.com/cubenewengland)
* [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/402975042172435)
* [Join our Facebook community for **parents**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/732527678812618)
* [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/3mX6xKUdRC)

Students & Staff of any MSAD54 school can compete in this competition free of charge. After you have registered for this competition (and prior to paying), please use your district-issued email address to email the organizer Tommy Chestnutt @ tchestnutt@msad54.org. After confirming your relationship with the district, your registration will be accepted. All other registration regulations remain the same (competiiton limits, registration timeline, etc.).

venue.name: Adarsha Vidya Mandir
venue.details: Common Hall, Second Floor, High School Section

items.information:
1. All competitors should be familiar with the information in all the tabs. If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the New Competitor Information tab before registering.
3. All the participants (excluding newcomers) are requested be ready to volunteer in the competition and will be asked to take on judging and running roles whenever necessary.
4. Make sure you are available at the venue 20 minutes prior to the end of check-in time and start of each round you're participating in.
5. Late arrival will lead to disqualification, unless you've informed the WCA Delegates in advance. You can find contact details in the "[Contact Us](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SideQuestatAVM2026#83920-contact-us)" tab.
6. The final decision and rights to accept/deny the exception request remains with the WCA Delegates.
7. If you're participating in a WCA competition for the first time, please bring a government or school ID card with Date of Birth for verification.

items.name: Vivira Winter Cube Open 2026
items.information:
**Please review all of the tabs listed on this website.**

*  Competitors are only allowed to register for a maximum of **four** events.

* Please see the "[Favorites Format](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ViviraWinterCubeOpen2026#84207-favorites-format)" tab for more info.

* The events will happen in the order listed on the "[Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ViviraWinterCubeOpen2026/#competition-schedule)" tab, but event durations are tentative! Check back the day before the competition, as event durations may change depending on the number of competitors in events.

* You only need to attend the events that you're competing in, though we encourage you to stay longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance just in case

* We won't be allowing late entry in the competition under any exceptions. Make sure you will be available at the venue when your name is called.

* Make sure you go through all the WCA regulations.

* Kindly bring your ID card while entering the venue.

* All Newcomers are requested to bring a valid ID proof that clearly mentions their Date of Birth (DOB) for verification purposes.

* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.

* Participants must bring their own cubes.
